quotes.text: The sidebar icon changed to --icon-more in D210978, then D210989 corrected its dark-theme color by exposing and coloring stroke instead of fill. Review said to test dark theme and the original author acknowledged the icon had changed after an earlier check. Current CSS still sets stroke. When swapping an SVG icon, inspect whether it paints with fill or stroke and check light and dark themes.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
